headline: Approved renewal of Second Class Liquor License for Standing Stones Wine at 33 Main Street.
summary: The city clerk reported a regular renewal with no concerns from Council or staff. Members approved the Second Class Liquor License for Standing Stones Wine at 33 Main Street.
decisions: Approved the Second Class Liquor License renewal for Standing Stones Wine at 33 Main Street, 4-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Discussion/Approval: Standing Stones Wine – 33 Main Street - Renewal ... A motion to approve the Second Class Liquor License made by Deputy Mayor Oakleaf and seconded by Councilor Ogilvie. Motion passed 4-0.
